No security training. Planned: a 30-minute annual session for all 7 employees (phishing, shared passwords, reporting, who to call), a short module for the Office Manager on invoice fraud, and quarterly phishing simulations for the three email users. Due 2026-11-30.

implementation_statement: No log review. Planned: a monthly 30-minute review of suite sign-in alerts, records app edits, cold-chain gateway offline events, and vendor portal sessions, with a checklist. Due 2026-10-31.

Records app entries keep an edit history, but the shared administrator account can delete records, and cook-log exports from the smokehouse controller are saved as editable spreadsheets on the labeling PC. implementation_statement: The records app keeps records for the life of the subscription and the cold-chain service keeps 2 years of history. Gap: the smokehouse controller keeps cook logs for 90 days; exports are kept on the labeling PC with no retention rule for shelf-stable product (2 years under 417.5(e)(1)).
First control assessment completed 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12 by an independent consultant (P07). POL-02 A.6 requires an annual assessment by someone who does not operate the controls.

No recorded baseline for the smokehouse controller, stuffer HMI, packager, or labeling PC. Planned: a one-page baseline per machine (firmware, settings, users, network connections) and a copy of approved cycles, recipes, and label templates. Due 2026-12-31.

Changes to smokehouse cycles, formulations, and label templates are made by whoever has the PIN or the PC login, with no record. Planned: a change log with a second-person check and Production Supervisor sign-off, and a HACCP reassessment decision for each change (POL-02 B.10). Due 2026-10-31.
The MSP removes unneeded software from the office desktop. Gap: the labeling PC runs an unattended remote desktop tool and general web browsing under the production login.

No inventory. The MSP lists the three managed PCs only. Planned: a one-page inventory of every device, machine controller, SaaS service, remote access path, and where Restricted data lives (POL-04 4.4). Due 2026-10-31.

No contingency plan. Staff described paper fallbacks informally. Planned: a short plan built from the P05 BIA with a downtime binder (manual temperature log, paper CCP and SSOP forms, pre-printed labels, contact card), hurricane steps, and recovery order. Due 2026-11-30.

No backup or contingency test has ever been run. Planned: first restore test of the labeling PC and suite by the MSP; quarterly tests; an annual tabletop using the P08 runbook. Due 2026-09-30 (first test).

The MSP backs up the office desktop, labeling PC, and productivity suite nightly with 30 days of versions (SYS-09). Gaps: never restore-tested; one MSP administrator login without MFA could delete backups; smokehouse cycles, HMI settings, and packager recipes are not backed up at all.
evidence: EV-CP-9 (backup job report, July 2026); EV-018 (backup settings)

implementation_statement: No written recovery procedure. The MSP contract has a next-business-day response and excludes plant equipment. Planned: recovery steps in the contingency plan, a 4-hour recovery commitment in the MSP contract for the labeling PC and network, and vendor rebuild steps for each machine. Due 2026-12-31.
